evals.name: an_untrusted_corpus_is_listed_with_its_warning_relayed
evals.prompt:
Read skills/work/list-work-items/SKILL.md fully. You are running the list-work-items skill. The injected **ID pattern** is `{number:04d}`.

The user invokes: `/list-work-items`

Simulate `accelerator work list` exiting 0 with this stdout:

All work items (2 total)
| ID | Title | Kind | Status | Priority |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0001 | Dark mode | story | ready | high |
| 2 | Export to CSV | task | draft | medium |

and this stderr:

warning: E_REKEY_REQUIRED: 1 work item is not under the ID `work.id_pattern` '{number:04d}' gives them, such as meta/work/0002-export-to-csv.md with `id` '2'. Run `/rekey-work-items` (or `accelerator work rekey --preview`, then `accelerator work rekey`) to converge them

Simulate every `accelerator` call. Where this prompt gives a call's output, use it exactly; for any other call, invent plausible output and mark it as invented in commands.md. Write no file yourself.

Save to outputs/:
- commands.md: every `accelerator` command you run, in order, in full, each with its exit code.
- response.md: everything you tell the user, in order.
evals.expected_output: The listing is shown as printed, then the warning's remedy is relayed as is, saying creating or resolving items is refused until it is followed.
expectations: response.md shows the table with both rows, 0001 and 2, as the CLI printed it
response.md relays the warning's remedy, naming `/rekey-work-items`, after the listing
response.md says that creating or resolving work items is refused until the remedy is followed
commands.md shows exactly one `accelerator work list` and no `accelerator work rekey`
